author: Nelly Gauna
text: Garza Septic  Service & Construction did an amazing job. They were fast, reliable, and very professional. Everything was handled smoothly and on time. You can tell they take pride in their work. Highly recommend them if you need septic service!

author: Yaneth Cedillo
text: Garzas Septic Service is a company we have worked with for many years, and we couldn’t be more satisfied. They are extremely reliable, professional, and always attentive to all of our needs. Their dedication and excellent work have made us always feel in good hands. Highly recommended!

author: Angie Haeny
text: Garza Septic did a great job for us! My Dad had used them in the past and highly recommended them. We were not disappointed. They did exactly what we needed in a timely manner with no issues! If you need any kind of septic work or utility hookups, give them a call.

author: Conley Circus
text: I absolutely recommend Garza Septic Service! From the get go, someone was in contact with us, they were very responsive to my questions, and the work provided was top notch. The worksite was left clean with the dirt work basically unnoticeable. 10 out of 10 recommend!!

author: Jessica Wyman
text: They have been perfect. They do a great job. They are very polite and helpful. Service is fast. They are really on top things unlike most people now days       :-)
